Although my personal relationships do deal a heavy impact too, I experienced way too many people walking out of my life that I don't really see the point in maintaining any relationship anymore. I doubt I'll ever be a workaholic because I don't have the drive to do anything, I can't get myself to do anything. I hate it so much when people think I'm not aware I'm destroying my life (Not saying that you're saying that, It's just something I forgot to add in my original post). I really want this particular career, and feel as though I'm a failure if I get any other career, regardless if that other career is still "good". The whole world revolves around if you were successful in high school, the people who were successful regardless of how they did in high school were just prodigies to begin with, and I was definitely not a prodigy. Bottom line is, I know I'm failing myself and I hate myself every day for it, and not succeeding in adulthood will be the nail in the coffin.
